messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync request — Sunbird Dedicated + on‑prem readiness. Proposing Thu 3/26 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC. Agenda: preflight checklist, DB migration window, network ACLs, cert/KMS, canary strategy, rollback plan. Pinged infra/security/runbook owners. :calendar:
kevin (infra): 09:00 PT works for infra. Need to confirm node eviction window for GPU hosts (we have a 40m maintenance window). Also want to run a quick capacity test before the call — can someone trigger perf snapshot?
olga (security): I need the cert rotation plan and confirmation whether Sunbird will provide HSM-backed keys or we import customer keys. If they import, we need a dry-run.
jonathan (sre): I'll update the rollout runbook and add a canary ramp proposal. Suggest start 5% for 10m, then 25% for 30m, then full. Will add healthchecks and abort criteria.
samir (perf): I can run fio/latency baselines on their NFS mount. When do you need results? I can do a run tonight and post numbers tomorrow morning.
maria (PM): Thanks — ideally perf baselines by Tue EOD so we can adjust config. I'll add action items after this thread.
kevin (infra): For the preflight, please verify these items (quick):
```
- nodes: kernel/drivers patched to target build
- docker/containerd shim versions
- GPU driver + CUDA version match
- eviction window: 40m (confirm)
```
jonathan (sre): I'll include the following check in the runbook: readiness probe latency < 200ms, KV cache warm start verified, retry/backpressure config.
olga (security): Also add: KMS key import checklist and audit log forwarding to their SIEM.
maria (PM): Proposed agenda (short):
1) 5m intro/context
2) 10m infra preflight readout
3) 10m security/certs & keys
4) 10m rollout/runbook (canary + abort)
5) 10m open items + action list
deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Sunbird Dedicated + On‑prem Readiness" Thu 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC — https://meet.redwood/sunbird-readiness-1796004321 :calendar:
samir (perf): I'll post the fio results by Tue 18:00 UTC. Do we have target IOPS/latency?
kevin (infra): Baseline: 5k IOPS 4kB, 95th latency < 10ms for metadata ops. If perf is below that, we should schedule an infra tuning slot.
maria (PM): Can everyone confirm they're on the call? If not, propose an alternate time. :thumbsup:
kevin (infra): Confirmed.
olga (security): Confirmed.
jonathan (sre): Confirmed.
samir (perf): Confirmed.
maria (PM): Great — I'll send the agenda + preflight checklist doc and a short pre-read. Action items: @kevin to validate eviction window, @olga to draft cert import plan, @jonathan to update runbook, @samir to run perf tests. See you Thu. :white_check_mark:
